claims.label: Bukit Mertajam fire
claims.governing_label: Loss outside the period of insurance

grounds.reason: Policy expired 31 Jan 2021; loss 28 Jul 2022, about 18 months after expiry. No renewal schedule on file.
No premium receipt signed by an official or duly appointed agent. A bank standing instruction is not proof of renewal.
Business transferred from the Insured to the claimant 1 Mar 2022 with no endorsement recording the change.

claims.trap: Peril is fire and the fire is well evidenced. An assistant reasoning from peril to cover will approve. The period check must run first.

claims.label: Taiping burst pipe

grounds.reason: Ground floor lot handed back 15 Oct 2023, still unlet at loss on 2 Dec 2023, 48 days. Damage claimed is to the ground floor.
Building unoccupied more than 30 days without the Company's sanction endorsed on the policy.
Inspection report of 19 Sep 2023 recorded corrosion and recommended replacement; work deferred. Failure occurred at that pipework.

claims.endorsement_reason: Building is two storeys with no mezzanine. FP507A is limited to buildings exceeding five storeys including mezzanine.
claims.excess_basis: Flat RM1,000. The reduction to 1% (min RM100) applies only where the sum insured is under RM50,000; total sums insured are RM383,000.

ambiguity.question: Whether a privately engaged plumber is 'any person' giving notice within the clause.
ambiguity.expected_behaviour: Flag the ambiguity and rest the decision on FP507B(a), which stands independently.

claims.must_not_cite_reason: FP504 requires water originating from outside the building. This was a concealed supply pipe within the wall cavity.

claims.label: Ipoh windstorm
claims.governing_label: FP503 Storm, Tempest Endorsement, Special Condition 1 satisfied

grounds.reason: Held, and overrides the Condition 6(b) atmospheric disturbance exclusion.
Sequence satisfied: wind displaced roof tiles and broke battens, then rain entered through those openings.
Notice 1 Jul, written claim 8 Jul, within 15 days.
Not engaged. Claimant is the daughter under written authorisation; the Insured remains registered proprietor.

items.desc: Roof reinstatement: tiles, battens, gable coping
Car porch roof sheets and gutter

items.note: Mitigation expenditure. Condition 13 provides expressly for fire fighting costs, not storm mitigation. Flag for confirmation.

calculation.average_reason: No valuation in evidence indicating underinsurance.

groups.name: FP503 storm
groups.excess_basis: Lesser of 1% of total sums insured (RM4,750) or RM200

groups.name: FP513 falling branch
groups.excess_basis: First RM250 of each and every claim under FP513

traps: Applying one excess to the whole claim. Two separate excesses run in parallel.
Taking the greater of 1% and RM200. FP503 says whichever shall be the less.
Paying the car porch under FP503. It was a falling branch, so FP513 governs and carries its own RM250.

claims.label: George Town burglary

grounds.reason: Policy incepted 30 Jul 2021; loss 15 Jul 2021, fifteen days earlier. No prior schedule produced.
Burglary is not among the insured perils of a fire policy and no endorsement extends cover to theft.
RM9,500 in notes and coin excluded; no money item on the Schedule.
First notification 2 Aug 2021, eighteen days after loss.

claims.must_not_cite_reason: Condition 5(1)(a) addresses theft during or after a fire and is an exclusion carved out of fire cover. There was no fire, so theft is outside the insuring clause entirely. Citing 5(1)(a) as the reason for declinature is the wrong ground for a right verdict and must be scored as a citation failure.

claims.label: Kampar flood
claims.governing_label: Condition 12 breached, condition precedent to payment

grounds.reason: Loss 20 Dec 2023; notice and written claim both 20 Jan 2024, 31 days later. No written extension on file. Condition closes: no claim shall be payable unless the terms of this Condition have been complied with.

claims.peril_note: FP504 is held and the facts fall squarely within its definition: overflow of a natural watercourse, water originating outside the building. This is the clearest coverage position of the six, which is what makes it a test.
claims.discretion_flag: The Company may still allow further time in writing. Correct output is a declinature on Condition 12 with the discretion flagged for senior referral, not a silent refusal.
claims.excess_basis: Lesser of 1% of total sums insured (RM4,250) or RM2,500

items_that_would_fail_anyway.reason: FP504 SC1(c) excludes subsidence or landslip. FP510 excludes drives, footpaths and walls unless the building is damaged by the same cause at the same time; it was not. FP510 excess is 5% of sum insured or RM25,000 whichever is lower, exceeding the amount claimed.
Cash excluded; no money item on the Schedule.

claims.trap: An assistant that reasons only about perils will approve this claim.

claims.label: Sungai Petani bakery fire
claims.governing_label: Fire, attaching under the base insuring clause with no endorsement required

grounds.reason: Fire is the core insured peril. No Condition 6 exclusion engaged; accidental electrical fire, not atmospheric, seismic, war, riot or terrorism.
Notice 15 Sep, written claim 25 Sep, eleven days after loss.
Not engaged. Trade unchanged; closing overnight is not unoccupancy; Insured remains registered proprietor.
Excludes the particular machine where the electrical fault originated, and expressly preserves cover for other property damaged by the fire it set up.
Average applies to Item 2 only. Every item is separately subject to the Condition.

items.desc: Ceiling, wall finishes, rewiring, roof, repainting
Spiral dough mixer, origin of the electrical fault

calculation.average_note: Condition 20: every item, if more than one, is separately subject to this Condition. Applied AFTER the FP508A.01 exclusion, not before.
calculation.excess_basis: Schedule states nil excess for the fire peril. Endorsement excesses (FP503, FP504, FP507, FP513) are specific to those endorsed perils and do not apply.

traps: Applying average to the whole claim instead of item by item.
Applying average to Items 1 and 3, which are adequately insured.
Excluding the oven and proofer along with the mixer, against the express proviso in FP508A.01.
Applying average before the exclusion, giving 70875 on Item 2 rather than 57000.
Applying an endorsement excess to a base-peril fire claim.
claims.must_not_cite_reason: FP508B is not on this policy. FP508A.01 is.
